what.text: This page follows refugees from Iran living in the United States, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4993 Iranian refugees in the United States, 3.2% of all refugees from Iran.
Germany hosts the most Iranian refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Canada and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iran in periods from 1986 to 2025, and over Kurdistan territory in periods from 1983 to 2018.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Iran and Iraq from 1983 to 1988.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at its highest figure, 37955 refugees.
It has fallen since then; the main years of displacement in the data are 1988 to 1992, 2001 to 2004 and 2006.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
These are year-end totals for the United States only, reported to UNHCR.
